title: 19th Annual Pershing Square Value Investing and Philanthropy Challenge
description: 19th Annual Pershing Square Value Investing and Philanthropy Challenge
summary: The speaker argues that Baker Hughes is a compelling compounder poised to transform into a service-based industrial energy technology business with significant margin expansion potential. In the beverage sector, the talk highlights Celsius Energy as an undervalued growth opportunity within the sugar-free category, noting its strong market position and potential for margin improvement. Conversely, the speaker expresses skepticism regarding Uber's ability to disrupt the US delivery duopoly and dismisses Tesla's prospects in autonomous delivery, while viewing Costco's grocery market exposure as having limited competitive threat from Instacart.
